rationale: Reconciler script exists (agentic_rustchain_reconcile.py) but has no systemd timer
Sweeper runs every 5 min but lacks reconciliation phase
#16845 MERGED_OR_PAID since 2026-09-02 but NOT in ledger = $0 realized
Without reconciliation, completed bounties never convert to revenue
Objective requires 'finalizar processos anteriores' - reconciliation IS finalization

implementation_plan.insert_position: BEFORE phase_claims_finalize (reconciliation must run first to update ledger status)

Reconciler is deterministic and read-only on public evidence
Only writes to bounty_receive_ledger.json via atomic rename
Does NOT move funds, create claims, or modify proposals
Existing __main__ guard prevents accidental import side effects
verification_steps: Run reconciler manually once to confirm it processes #16845
Verify ledger entry appears with status wallet_received
Confirm sweeper timer still fires every 5 min after modification
Check supervisor logs for reconciliation phase execution
note: This proposal does NOT modify any files. Implementation requires owner approval per safety policy.
